blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Quirino Governor Dakila “Dax” Cua never changed despite rising through various elective positions, Marikina Rep. Miro Quimbo said on Monday. Quimbo said this in his eulogy for Cua during the necrological service at the Batasang Pambansa complex, recalling their first meeting at a housing project in Quirino in 2006, when Quimbo was head of the Pag-IBIG Fund and Cua was the province’s vice governor. According to Quimbo, Cua dragged him away from the spotlight because he found discussions among the elders—his father, former Gov.
